strategyFamily: fully collateralized BTC spot/perpetual funding and basis carry
selectionDisclosure: Trial 16 is a new numbered successor selected after Trial 2U historical source-replication evidence. Trial 2U showed positive carry but failed its frozen +25/+50/+100 percent adverse-perpetual-mark collateral stresses. Trial 16 changes only the futures collateral reserve from 20% to 50% of starting equity; 50% was fixed before any post-2026-03-01 funding, perpetual execution, mark-price, basis, or carry P&L was acquired or observed. All trade economics otherwise remain inherited from Trial 2/2U.

developmentEvidence.limitation: 20% futures collateral failed the frozen +25%, +50%, and +100% adverse-perpetual-mark stresses.

candidate.position: long BTC spot and short exactly equal BTC units of Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual
candidate.entryRule: enter once at the first exact 8-hour funding boundary in the frozen confirmation window; no forecast, funding-sign filter, or timing optimization
candidate.exitRule: exit both legs at the final exact 8-hour funding boundary strictly before the frozen end
candidate.perpetualShortSizingRule: short exactly the BTC units purchased by the 15%-of-starting-equity spot leg
candidate.fundingAccounting: entry-boundary funding is excluded; later realized funding is accrued on equal BTC units times contemporaneous mark price; short receives positive funding and pays negative funding
candidate.basisAccounting: standard perpetual contract opens are execution references; mark-price opens are valuation/funding/margin references

confirmationWindow.reason: This interval begins exactly where the previously observed Trial 2U historical window ended and was not used in Trial 2/2U carry economics.

dataRequirements.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY BTCUSDT 8h spot klines
dataRequirements.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M BTCUSDT standard 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualMark: checksum-verified union of MONTHLY and DAILY USD-M BTCUSDT 8h markPriceKlines; overlap must agree exactly and every boundary must be covered
dataRequirements.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M BTCUSDT fundingRate archives

promotionCriteria.interpretation: Every criterion must pass. Passing authorizes a separate paper-baseline promotion proposal only; never real-money trading. Failure freezes Trial 16 with no in-place rescue.

antiRescueRule: After the first confirmation-window economic output, no collateral, sizing, dates, costs, source rule, funding filter, entry/exit rule, or promotion threshold may change under Trial 16.
